```
['run the PatchTSTModel encoder on time series past values to get hidden state representations', 'build a PatchTSTForPretraining model for masked patch pretraining on multivariate time series', 'train a PatchTSTForPrediction model to forecast future time series values from past observations', 'classify time series sequences using PatchTSTForClassification with configurable pooling and cls token', 'regress time series inputs to continuous target values using PatchTSTForRegression with optional distribution output']
```

